text:
Alex W: quick question — do we go coarse-grained unified endpoint (single /api/run with action types) or many resource endpoints for internal RPCs? Thinking about rollout UX, telemetry, and SDK generation.
Jamie K: I'm leaning gRPC/protobufs internally. Strong typing, auto SDKs, streaming for long polls. But browser + 3rd party callers want JSON.
Maria S: Agreed. For console we'd prefer stable per-route metrics. With a unified endpoint we lose route-level telemetry unless gateway adds decoded route id.
Sam R: Can we have gateway extract a header or decode a proto envelope to set route tag? e.g., `x-rd-route: model.generate.v2` — then dashboard shows per-route latency/cost.
Alex W: yeah that's one option. Another is have the gateway translate gRPC to REST and set `x-route` based on method. But grpc-gateway translation breaks streaming and increases complexity.
Jamie K: tradeoffs: grpc-web solves browser but requires envoy+wasm shims. We already run envoy at edge. Are we ok operating grpc-web for hosted API?
Maria S: operation-wise it's fine but means more client surface area. Also protobuf evolution: prefer `oneof` fields vs always adding new methods. How will rollouts work? Canary by header vs percentage?
Sam R: rollout UX: header-based canary is simplest (`x-rd-canary: canary-xxx`). We can do weighted routing in the control plane. But the client SDK should expose `pinModelVersion()` to make it deterministic.
Alex W: Right. For SDK parity we need generated clients from proto to match REST semantics. Otherwise developers get inconsistent ergonomics.
Jamie K: Proposal: internal services use gRPC+proto3 with reserved field numbers for evolution; edge gateway exposes REST/JSON for public API. Gateway sets `x-rd-route` and `x-rd-method` so console can attribute telemetry. Streaming endpoints remain proxied using gRPC-web or a dedicated SSE path.
Maria S: Can we add trace enrichment: `x-rd-operation` and `x-rd-caller-tier` to capture quota vs rate-limit buckets? Console wants cost per-caller-tier.
Sam R: example header snippet: ```http
x-rd-route: v1.model.generate
x-rd-operation: generate-text
x-rd-caller-tier: free
x-request-id: 01F...
```
Alex W: +1. Also need to document proto deprecation process: mark fields reserved, soft-deprecation via `deprecated=true` in comments, then remove after 2 releases.
Jamie K: one more ops note: metrics exporter should label by `route` and `method`, not by HTTP path. That avoids churning when gateway routes change.
deploy-bot: canary deploy started for api-gateway-2 on prod-us-west at 13:52 UTC :rocket:
Maria S: cool — let's capture action items: (1) RFC for gateway header mapping, (2) proto evolution doc + deprecation schedule, (3) SDK generation pipeline for public/edge parity. I'll take (1). Alex takes (2). Jamie takes (3).
Sam R: sounds good. I'll follow up about grpc-web perf numbers.
Alex W: thanks all — quick sync tomorrow to finalize.
